title: dryopteris abrupta
intro: Dryopteris abrupta, commonly known as wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of wood fern include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris abrupta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
